The '''Cjaalysce'I 500''' was a [[swoopchasing]] even that formed part of the [[Triple Crown]]. Held in [[Cjaalysce'I]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]], the even was sponsored by [[Pret Swain]] and the [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]].<ref name="BSS" />
